name: typed-app
title: Typed app build
description: A Closure Library-based app (`tools/bench/app/`: a notes editor written for this benchmark, three goog.module/goog.provide files on top of goog.editor, goog.ui, goog.net, goog.storage and the library's own editor demo plugins `goog.demos.editor.*`) compiled with the whole of Closure Library v20230802 (`closure/goog` and `third_party/closure/goog`, tests excluded, 971 files) as candidate inputs; `--dependency_mode=PRUNE` keeps the app's transitive goog.module/goog.provide dependencies.
mode: ADVANCED, type checking on (`--jscomp_warning=checkTypes`), source map
